def solve(data):
    n, edges = data
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    in_degree = [0] * n
    for u, v in edges:
        adj[u].append(v)
        in_degree[v] += 1
    import heapq
    pq = [i for i in range(n) if in_degree[i] == 0]
    heapq.heapify(pq)
    result = []
    while pq:
        u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        result.append(u)
        for v in adj[u]:
            in_degree[v] -= 1
            if in_degree[v] == 0:
                heapq.heappush(pq, v)
    if len(result) != n:
        return []
    return result

def solve(data):
    address, routes = data
    parts = list(map(int, address.split('.')))
    ip_int = (parts[0] << 24) | (parts[1] << 16) | (parts[2] << 8) | parts[3]
    for cidr, label in routes:
        octets = list(map(int, cidr.split('/')))
        network = (octets[0] << 24) | (octets[1] << 16) | (octets[2] << 8) | octets[3]
        prefix_len = octets[4]
        mask = (0xFFFFFFFF << (32 - prefix_len)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        if (ip_int & mask) == (network & mask):
            return label
    return None

def solve(data):
    capacity, refill_rate, events = data
    tokens = capacity
    current_time = 0
    results = []
    for time, cost in events:
        elapsed = time - current_time
        current_time = time
        tokens = min(capacity, tokens + elapsed * refill_rate)
        if tokens >= cost:
            tokens -= cost
            results.append(True)
        else:
            results.append(False)
    return results
